contract: notes-based free-form part/pivot contract for prop_ch02_local_wind_flag_component separated mechanism parts (stage 2). Candidate only; runtime proof (normal/slow/stop/reverse/calm) is a separate gate.

shared_plane.note: both layers are full-plane RGBA masters; no per-layer bbox fit or stretching

fixed_pole.contents: complete tilted wooden pole, top rope wrap/tie, mid rope knot + hanging tail, stone pile, wooden base platform; pole right edge repaired where the cloth seam touched it (129 px reassigned, 0 px repainted)

movable_blank_cloth.contents: separate blank off-white linen cloth: body + fold shading + dark outline + white inner-fold wedge (opaque white region between pole and cloth in the accepted reference, owned by the cloth as its inner face); no symbols, no rope

attach_top.desc: cloth top corner tucked under the top rope wrap

attach_bottom.desc: cloth gathered corner at the mid rope knot

seam_axis.desc: straight seam axis between the two attachment points; the cloth hangs/flutters from this axis

swing_pivot.desc: primary rotation pivot = top attachment point (cloth hangs from the top tie; bottom corner swings)

secondary_pivot.desc: bottom attachment point; small local rotation allowed

flutter.guidance: ordinary local wind only: slow sine sway ~0.5-1 Hz at runtime scale, amplitude within the ranges above. No storm/high-wind deformation, no whole-pole rotation, no magic/FX. Values are worker-recommended safe ranges (notes-based), not measured from animation.

runtime_cell_size.note: metadata only; Hermes performs final downsample/atlas packing
